Mr. Jahanzeb Panhwar, Advocate for the petitioner.
1. Learned counsel for the petitioner pleads urgency. Urgency granted.
2-4. Through this petition, the petitioner seeks appointment under
the deceased quota on account of the death of his father,
Muhammad Younus son of Muhammad Rahim, who was serving as
a Dark Room Attendant (BPS-09) at Civil Hospital, Karachi, and died
during service on 26.04.2012.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner
is entitled to consideration for appointment under Section 11-A of
the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973, as applicable to his case. He
further submits that the petitioner has already submitted an
application to the concerned authorities (available at page 33 of the
Court file), which has also been forwarded to the competent
authority; however, no decision has been taken thereon so far.
Syed Ahmed Zaidi, learned Additional Advocate General,
body: Sindh, who is present in Court in connection with other matters, waives notice on behalf of the official respondents and submits that he has no objection if the competent authority is directed to decide the petitioner's pending application strictly in accordance with law. In view of the above, and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the petitioner's claim or his entitlement to appointment, this petition is disposed of with a direction to the Secretary, Health Department, Government of Sindh, to examine and decide the petitioner's pending application through a reasoned and speaking order, strictly in accordance with law, including the applicable statutory provisions and the legal position governing appointments under the deceased quota, within ninety (90) days from the date of receipt of this order. The decision shall be communicated to the petitioner without unnecessary delay. The petition, along with the pending applications, stands disposed of in the above terms.
JUDGE HEAD OF CONST. BENCHES JUDGE Azeem
